summary: Fairfax Financial filed a 6-K attaching an October 7, 2026 press release announcing agreements with Wittington Investments, the Weston family holding company, to acquire Boots from The Boots Group. Total purchase price is approximately US$8.9 billion including assumed debt. Fairfax committed up to roughly US$2.3 billion via an equity commitment letter and expects to own 50% of Boots equity post-close, with Wittington holding operational control and Galen Weston as Chair. Closing is expected in Q1 2027, subject to customary conditions; Benavides and Alliance Healthcare Deutschland are excluded. Watch regulatory and financing conditions, partnership governance, and retail/pharmacy execution risk.
